source.title: An interaction-based foundation of aggregate investment fluctuations
source.author: Makoto Nirei

mission: Reproduce the benchmark Table 2 using a single executable Julia workflow, finite-firm endogenous investment shocks, and ES1 equilibrium selection.
reference_priority: Julia official documentation and standard libraries
Official package documentation and maintained source repositories

dependencies.policy: Verify versions/API against original package repositories; add only needed packages; save Project.toml and Manifest.toml when implementing.

algorithm_order: calculate constants steady state and A
solve Appendix A B\D and stable saddle path
initialize firm heterogeneity capital gaps and aggregate capital
compute approximate expectations from current state
compute threshold coefficients and switching points
enumerate all finite-firm aggregate-capital fixed points by sorted threshold sweep
select ES1 minimizing absolute log realized vs expected investment deviation
update exact firm capital and endogenous investment shock
recover macro quantities using log-linear expected-equilibrium conditions
save macro series and advance state
discard burn-in and compute 10-run moments and standard errors

equilibrium.criterion: min |log(X_actual)-log(X_expected)| among admissible finite-firm fixed points
equilibrium.fictitious_tatonnement: The basic best-response iteration is associated with ES2, not the benchmark ES1.
equilibrium.switch_point_method: sort 2N thresholds, update the power-sum at crossings, test each constant-response interval
equilibrium.complexity: O(N log N) per period sorting, O(N) scan, O(N) workspace
equilibrium.nonpositive_investment: never silently clip or log; record exception/explicit handling

approximations.expectations: continuum economy and first-order log-linear rational-expectations solution
approximations.realizations: finite N nonlinear indivisible investments and exact aggregate equation (13)
approximations.finite_vs_linear_capital: retain distinct quantities and document mapping; no arbitrary shock adjustments
approximations.initial_capital: provisional construction from uniform gaps; finite-sample scaling choice documented
approximations.timing: use consistent t and t+1 index; equation (13) productivity index discrepancy must be recorded

deliverables: averaged moments and Monte Carlo standard errors
completion: Execute benchmark at N=110000 for 1100 periods and 10 replications, discard first 100 periods, write Table 2 comparison files; report deviations honestly.
prohibited: implement in another language before translating to Julia
create unrelated research extensions or validation projects
claim replication before running the full benchmark
